card.name: Just before MDS blood-disorder terms
card.fires_on: Small words, slashes and the first letter of 'MDS' (myelodysplastic syndrome) that come right before or inside the term MDS or a blood-cell term. Seen in text about MDS, leukemia and blasts in the blood.

modes.label: Linking words before MDS
modes.description: A short word such as for, of, to or risk that sits just ahead of the term MDS.
modes.example: Planning Treatment<< for>> MDS Since a stem cell transplant

modes.label: Slash, comma or first letter in MDS lists
modes.description: A slash, comma or the letter M inside or beside MDS, MDS/MPD lists.

modes.label: Words before blood
modes.description: A small word that comes just before 'the blood' in a description of blasts.
